activity_summary: You said the day was one line and two locks. The tradesmen can wait. Nobody has asked for the next page, and you are not writing one to feel ready. The nights are named. The joke is crossed. Five mornings, and then the sixth.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the line, the locks, and the wait.

facets.activity: Shut the book on the week

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Nobody has asked for the next page, and I am not writing one to feel ready.
